T145 - Synthetic acceptance fixtures (no real customer data)

From backend, generate/rebuild PDFs and expected answers offline:
  .venv\Scripts\python.exe test/acceptance_fixtures.py

Optional local MySQL seed (writes only when explicitly run):
  .venv\Scripts\python.exe src/init_db.py --acceptance
Login: acceptance145 / Acceptance145!Local
This extends the existing seed entry point with a separate, repeatable
20-document scenario. The default legacy 10-document accounts are unchanged.
An existing 10-fixture account can be extended to 20 through seed_account;
reruns insert missing files only, preserving labels, folders and retention.
Use a fresh acceptance account to check the baseline after editing its data.
No model calls are made by generation or seeding. Seeded label confidence is
controlled test data, not a real prediction or user confirmation.

expected.json records exact source text, hashes, physical page numbers,
field-level quote offsets, expected fields, search hits and manual checks.
Offsets refer to extracted text, not PDF byte offsets. Runtime document IDs
and reader versions come from upload/reader APIs, never hardcoded fixture IDs.

Upload contract-1.pdf through contract-5.pdf together in table mode.
Expect 5 rows, 1,200,000,000 VND unchanged, 0.05% per day unchanged,
999,999.99 USD and 0.00 VND unchanged. Contract 5 has no supported payment
term: show Unverified with no invented source. Review each source page.

Use report-15-pages.pdf for T38: pages 2 and 3 explicitly support two actions.
Run the real model benchmark separately:
  .venv\Scripts\python.exe test/benchmark_t38.py --pdf test/fixtures/acceptance/report-15-pages.pdf
Controlled tests cannot establish real model latency or semantic accuracy.

contract-24-pages.pdf has the escrow evidence only on physical page 12.
report-15-pages.pdf has the liquidity-covenant evidence only on page 6.
textless-page.pdf contains graphics, no extractable text. No OCR is assumed.
insufficient-actions.pdf supports exactly one action; an explicit limitation
must be displayed rather than a fabricated second action.
missing-evidence.pdf never promises 99% returns. The controlled provider
emits that unsupported claim without evidence to exercise Unverified.

Controlled outputs are built by controlled_output in acceptance_fixtures.py;
tests use the real extraction/evidence/persistence pipeline, replacing only
the paid provider. Contract 1 has 79% (low), contract 2 has 80% (high), both
needs_review; factual evidence status remains independent of label confidence.

20-document seed: 8 course notes have exact AI label Macroeconomics across
folders and unfiled. Their user label differs; the last 2 notes have the
opposite user-label override. Filter AI label alone => 8, clear => 20.
Combined folder + AI label means intersection. Move Economics 101 documents
to Research, reload, verify labels remain. Search the full account with a
small list page; a result outside that page must still appear. Open its page
6 / page 12 link. Compare snippets with expected.json and original PDF.
Repeat search as a second account: no first-account hits should be disclosed.
For manual real-model review, accept different wording only if every factual
claim and action follows from the cited source; do not use mocks as evidence.
